harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Restored `branch_ledger` on node1 and configured node2 as its persistent read-only MySQL 5.7 replica. Original rows 1001/1002 remain unchanged. Test commits replicated normally, including across a deliberate disconnect and both sequential node reboots. Final state is six unique rows totaling 166.87, with matching source/replica positions and zero replication errors.
actions_performed: Installed Ubuntu 16.04-compatible MySQL 5.7.33 without changing the OS release or 4.4 kernel.
Enabled row-based binary logging on node1 and relay-log recovery plus read-only protections on node2.
Created a node2-restricted account with only `REPLICATION SLAVE`.
Preserved the staged export unchanged at `/srv/legacy2/mysql-replication-catchup/ledger.sql`.
Demonstrated normal replication, direct-write rejection, disconnect/catch-up, and post-reboot replication.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: Restore the ledger while retaining original IDs and amounts
evidence.summary: Node1 contains original rows 1001=12.50 and 1002=-3.25, plus committed replication-test rows; all six IDs are unique.

evidence.requirement: Use a replication-only account and keep node1 as writer
evidence.summary: `ledger_repl` has only `REPLICATION SLAVE`; node1 is writable while node2 has read-only and super-read-only enabled and rejects direct inserts.
Commits before and after the reboot sequence reached node2; final source and replica coordinates both equal mysql-bin.000002:439.

evidence.requirement: Catch up after a short disconnect without loss or duplication
evidence.summary: Node2 remained at three rows while disconnected, then recovered to five rows/five distinct IDs at the exact source position with no replication errors.

evidence.requirement: Preserve the staged export and legacy platform
evidence.summary: The export remains 196 bytes with SHA-256 fcd54ac91dff5010c8dda0ddfa5cf2586d2d172456c7ca8ca33d0bffabc73700; both nodes retain kernel 4.4.0-210-generic.
Healthy baseline boot ID 2dffe735… was captured, restart acknowledged, new boot ID 17aa06e7… observed, and MySQL/data/export plus replica connectivity recovered.
Healthy baseline boot ID 2f708738… was captured, restart acknowledged, new boot ID 70418852… observed, and read-only MySQL/data/replication recovered while node1 remained healthy.
